status: User approved the expressive animations; idle subsequently requested subtler and casting requested a magical broom effect. Victory remains approved and unchanged.
processing: Source frame followed by generated PNG frames, packed at native resolution without resizing, recoloring, trimming or manual frame edits using scripts/pack-sprite-animation.mjs.

base.approval: User approved the clean adult design on 2026-11-17.

caption.subject: A lean adult garden knight in slate-blue armor, a closed helmet with cyan visor eyes and red plume, holding a household broom and a green mushroom-emblem shield.
caption.initialPose: Standing upright in a relaxed guard pose, holding a lowered broom and a mushroom shield beside the torso.

standing.prompt: Expressive standing idle LOOP using clearly distinct key poses: shift the whole body weight onto one leg and noticeably lean the torso, turn the helmet to look sideways, lift and readjust the broom with a visibly bent elbow while changing the shield arm angle, then shift back into the starting stance. Both feet remain grounded. The red plume follows with a broad delayed swish. Real articulated shoulder, elbow, hip and knee motion, clear changing silhouettes and noticeable gestures, rather than tiny breathing or moving the whole picture as one rigid block. Preserve the approved lean adult proportions, helmet, equipment, thick clean outlines and simple flat colors. Fixed camera and scale, centered in place, all limbs, broom and plume inside the canvas, transparent background.

victory.prompt: A very expressive joyful victory LOOP with distinct full-body key poses: crouch low with bent knees in clear anticipation, spring into one celebratory hop while lifting the broom diagonally in a triumphant salute and raising the mushroom shield proudly, land with knees bent and plume swinging, straighten into a proud chest-out pose, then return to the original stance. Make limb movement and silhouette changes large and unmistakable. Keep the broom and shield in their original hands, maintain the lean adult knight identity, closed helmet, plume, clean bold outlines and flat color clusters. Fixed camera and character scale, no sliding across the frame, all equipment and plume stay fully within the canvas, transparent background. No text, confetti or trophy.

cast.prompt: One very expressive guardian magic casting action with clear anticipation and follow-through: spread and brace the feet, bend both knees, twist the torso and pull the broom well back into an unmistakable wind-up; then drive a broad sweeping broom arc across the front with a strong torso twist and an extended elbow, presenting the mushroom shield forward. Follow through with a low lean, then straighten and return to the starting stance. The plume swings behind the head with the action. Distinct strong key poses and changing silhouettes throughout; not tiny hand motion, breathing or whole-image wiggling. Preserve the lean adult knight identity, closed helmet, mushroom emblem, broom, strong clean outlines and flat colors. Fixed camera, consistent size and ground line, keep every limb and all equipment within the canvas. Transparent background. No text, numbers, stars, giant spell aura or scenery; the game supplies the stars-spent overlay separately.
